reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and reads group notes from the existing notes table, but matches the tag with its own regex instead of the shared extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The tag test is one predicate, but the notes join is written into both getMonthWideCategories and getBudgetData and the predicate is invoked separately in copyPreviousMonth, because that pre-existing action still bypasses the shared selection.

placement.why: The predicate and joins live in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide selection logic.

scope.why: Only the #fixed rule and its tests are added.

maintainability.why: A named predicate applied inside the shared selection is easy to own; the second application in copyPreviousMonth and the private tag regex are small liabilities.

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroupNote uses its own FIXED_GROUP_TAG regex rather than the existing extractTagsFromText tag parser.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated notes join is verbatim; nothing is disguised.

one_place.where: isFixedGroupNote in budget/actions.ts, applied in getMonthWideCategories (setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) and in copyPreviousMonth's loop over getBudgetData.
